title: AI commoditizes the translation layer between intent and artifact while human judgment governs problem definition
text: AI models dramatically lower the cost of the translation layer—turning natural language intent into functional code, schemas, and drafts. However, identifying which problems are worth solving, arbitrating trade-offs, and enforcing organizational quality standards remain irreducibly human constraints.
qualification: Architectural essay separating translation from strategic definition; conceptual taxonomy rather than audited workforce time studies.

public_locator.value: The translation layer is collapsing to zero marginal cost; the definition of what to build is not.
